Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 44

“For those attached to pleasure and power, whose minds are carried away by such talk, the resolute understanding settled in concentration does not arise.”

Attachment is described as a theft of attention rather than as a sin. A mind already spent on outcomes has nothing left over for the steadiness Krishna is describing.
